The fixed basket rate is $\sum_i w_i r_i$. All categories must have consistent, named price-change periods. The cost scenario retains fixed quantities. Published CPI and HCES data differ in methodology; do not interpret a simulated burden as the official CPI.

The shipped monthly CPI rows are deliberately sparse. To run ARIMA forecasting, import a verified contiguous CPI 2024-base monthly series covering at least 24 months. Read `docs/research-methodology.md` for full details.
